title: Oil extraction report from Chlamydomonas reinhardtii engineered to produce ketocarotenoids
author: Ceschi, Edoardo
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Harvest and pellet cells
steps.instruction: Collect the saturated Chlamydomonas reinhardtii EN1 culture and centrifuge to pellet the cells. Perform separate harvests for the following culture volumes: 300 mL, 600 mL, 900 mL, 1 800 mL (lab‑scale) and 5 400 mL, 7 200 mL, 9 000 mL, 10 800 mL (large‑scale multi‑cycle samples).

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in sunflower oil
steps.instruction: Add 25 mL of sunflower oil to each wet‑biomass pellet (lab‑scale samples) and mix thoroughly to dissolve the cells. For the large‑scale extractions, add oil to keep the same oil‑to‑biomass ratio as the lab scale (i.e., the same volume of oil per unit volume of wet culture).

steps.title: Separate oil phase by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the oil‑suspended samples to separate the oil phase from the cell debris. Collect the clear oil extract from the top of each tube.

steps.title: Dilute oil extracts for spectrophotometry
steps.instruction: Dilute each collected oil extract in fresh sunflower oil according to the sample specification:

substeps.instruction: Sample 1x (300 mL culture): dilute 1:10 before measuring the absorption spectrum.
Sample 2x (600 mL culture): dilute 1:100 before measuring.
Sample 3x (900 mL culture): dilute 1:100 before measuring.
Sample 6x (1 800 mL culture): dilute 1:1000 before measuring.
Sample 6x 3rd cycle (5 400 mL culture): dilute 1:1000 before measuring.
Sample 6x 4th cycle (7 200 mL culture): dilute 1:1000 before measuring.
Sample 6x 5th cycle (9 000 mL culture): dilute 1:1000 before measuring.
Sample 6x 6th cycle (10 800 mL culture): dilute 1:1000 before measuring.

steps.title: Measure absorption spectrum
steps.instruction: Record the absorption spectrum of each diluted oil extract. Use the spectra to calculate ketocarotenoid concentration as described in Perozeni et al., Plant Biotechnology Journal 2020.

steps.title: Large‑scale multi‑cycle extraction
steps.instruction: Process 200 g of total dry biomass (derived from 250 L of saturated culture) in three independent extractions (Extraction 1, Extraction 2, Extraction 3).

substeps.instruction: Extraction 1: perform on wet biomass using the same oil‑to‑biomass ratio as the lab‑scale protocol; after centrifugation, recycle the oil extract for up to a fourth cycle, diluting the final extract 1:1000 before spectrophotometric analysis.
Extraction 2: perform on dry biomass; after centrifugation, recycle the oil extract for up to a fourth cycle, diluting 1:1000 before analysis.
Extraction 3: perform on dry biomass; recycle the oil extract for up to a fourth cycle, diluting 1:1000 before analysis.
After Extractions 1 and 2, take the final pellet and perform a second extraction in fresh sunflower oil (samples “2nd extraction 1” and “2nd extraction 2”).
